snippet.title: Yakuza 0 Director’s Cut – Launch Trailer | Nintendo Switch™ 2
snippet.description:
Yakuza 0 Director's Cut is now available on Nintendo Switch 2! 
Buy now: https://www.sega.com/like-a-dragon-yakuza/yakuza-0-directors-cut

Play the definitive edition of the critically acclaimed origin story with never-before-seen cutscenes, new online multiplayer mode, English voiceover, plus French, Italian, German, and Spanish text.

#Yakuza0DirectorsCut #NintendoSwitch2
